hooks.name: Validate Test Coverage
hooks.description: On save of a source file with behaviour, verify a co-located test exists and covers the happy path, error paths, and (where the input space is large) a tagged property-based test.

action.prompt:
A source file was just saved. Assess its TEST coverage against the tdd and test-coverage steering. Steps:
1. If the saved file is itself a test (*.test.ts / *.test.tsx), a type-only module (pure interfaces/types), or a trivial presentational-only component, reply that no test is required and stop.
2. Otherwise locate the co-located test (foo.ts -> foo.test.ts, Foo.tsx -> Foo.test.tsx). If it is MISSING, flag it and outline the specific test cases that should exist.
3. If it exists, check it tests observable behaviour at the right boundary (service vs mocked repo; repository vs in-memory SQLite; routes via Fastify inject; hooks/store as units; components via RTL; network via MSW) and that it covers the ERROR paths (404/409/400, network failure, parse failure, no-mutation-on-failure), not just the happy path.
4. If the file has a large input space (id generation, diffing, row mapping, pagination, filtering, validation, aggregation/P&L), verify there is a fast-check property test with >=100 runs, tagged exactly `// Feature: trade-blotter, Property N: <text>`.
5. Run the affected test file(s) with `npx vitest run <path>` and confirm green.
Report a short PASS/FAIL summary with concrete gaps. Do not add tests unless asked; just report.
